name: Sunday House
eyebrow: A fresh start for your space
headline:
Come home to
more breathing room.
intro: A light-filled approach to recurring cleaning, one-time resets and the details that help a team plan your home.
about_title: Every room has its own rhythm.
about_body: Sunday House is a fictional home cleaning brand with an alternate bright-interior design. It shows a concise plan builder and how service-specific proof could be presented honestly.
tagline: A home that feels easier to be in.
split_title: A plan that starts with your rooms.
split_body: A real team confirms room count, condition, access, supplies, exclusions and written pricing. The sample flow shows preferences without inventing a cleaning quote.
services: Discuss weekly, biweekly or monthly service, the priority rooms and what remains outside the standard scope.
Note pets, access and the preferred day.
A first visit may need additional time based on condition and priorities. A provider confirms the scope after reviewing the space.
Describe the rooms and particular focus areas.
Confirm access, utilities, appliances, fixtures and any property-specific requirements before an agreed plan.
Ask for a written room-by-room scope.
steps: A real provider checks size, condition and access.
Confirm scope, price and timing in writing.
faqs: Is the plan an instant quote?
No. The local planner creates a summary, not a binding price.
No invented testimonials appear. Add verified service-specific reviews with permission.
Does a date reserve a cleaner?
No. It is an example preference only.
note: Use example room details. Nothing is sent and no cleaner is reserved.
tool_title: A simple plan for the rooms that matter.
tool_intro: Choose room range, frequency and date preference; a real provider would confirm the actual scope and price.
proof: Show verified comments tied to a service type.
Make inclusions and exclusions easy to compare.
Confirm access, pets and supplies before a visit.
photos: Original illustrative scene for the cleaning services website
